title: Vasilije in Cacak
statementMd:
Aca and Milovan, two fellow competitive programmers, decided to give Vasilije a problem to test his skills.

Vasilije is given three positive integers: 𝑛n, 𝑘k, and 𝑥x, and he has to determine if he can choose 𝑘k distinct integers between 11 and 𝑛n, such that their sum is equal to 𝑥x.

Since Vasilije is now in the weirdest city in Serbia where Aca and Milovan live, Cacak, the problem seems weird to him. So he needs your help with this problem.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer 𝑡t (1≤𝑡≤1041≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The only line of each test case contains three integers 𝑛n, 𝑘k and 𝑥x (1≤𝑛≤2⋅1051≤n≤2⋅105, 1≤𝑘≤𝑛1≤k≤n, 1≤𝑥≤4⋅10101≤x≤4⋅1010) — the maximum element he can choose, the number of elements he can choose and the sum he has to reach.

Note that the sum of 𝑛n over all test cases **may exceed** 2⋅1052⋅105.

## Output

For each test case output one line: "`YES`", if it is possible to choose 𝑘k distinct integers between 11 and 𝑛n, such that their sum is equal to 𝑥x, and "`NO`", if it isn't.

You can output the answer in any case (for example, the strings "`yEs`", "`yes`", "`Yes`", and "`YES`" will be recognized as a positive answer).

## Note

In the first test case 𝑛=5, 𝑘=3, 𝑥=10n=5, k=3, x=10, so we can choose the numbers: 22, 33, 55, whose sum is 1010, so the answer is "`YES`".

In the second test case 𝑛=5, 𝑘=3, 𝑥=3n=5, k=3, x=3, there is no three numbers which satisfies the condition, so the answer is "`NO`". It can be shown that there are no three numbers whose sum is 33.
statementZhMd:
Aca 和 Milovan 是两名竞争性编程选手，他们决定给 Vasilije 出一道题来测试他的能力。

给定三个正整数：n、k 和 x，Vasilije 需要判断是否可以从 1 到 n 中选出 k 个互不相同的整数，使它们的总和等于 x。

由于 Vasilije 现在身处塞尔维亚最奇怪的城市——Aca 和 Milovan 居住的恰恰克，这道题在他看来十分奇怪。因此，他需要你的帮助来解决这个问题。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 t（1≤t≤10<sup>4</sup>）——测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例仅包含一行，其中有三个整数 n、k 和 x（1≤n≤2⋅10<sup>5</sup>，1≤k≤n，1≤x≤4⋅10<sup>10</sup>）——可以选择的最大元素、可以选择的元素数量以及需要达到的总和。

注意，所有测试用例中的 n 之和**可能超过** 2⋅10<sup>5</sup>。

## 输出格式

对于每个测试用例，输出一行：如果可以从 1 到 n 中选出 k 个互不相同的整数，使它们的总和等于 x，则输出“`YES`”；否则输出“`NO`”。

答案可以使用任意大小写形式输出（例如，字符串“`yEs`”、“`yes`”、“`Yes`”和“`YES`”都会被识别为肯定答案）。

## 说明

在第一个测试用例中，n=5，k=3，x=10，因此我们可以选择数字：2、3、5，它们的总和为 10，所以答案是“`YES`”。

在第二个测试用例中，n=5，k=3，x=3，不存在满足条件的三个数字，因此答案是“`NO`”。可以证明不存在三个数字使它们的总和为 3。
